newsitem.title: USA: ACCEL Int'l to sell auto after-market unit.
newsitem.headline: ACCEL Int'l to sell auto after-market unit.

text.p: ACCEL International Corp said Wednesday it has agreed in principle to sell its auto after-market product group along with the stock of its Acceleration Life Insurance Co subsidiary and two other subsidiaries to Frontier Insurance Group Inc Inc.
The amount of the transaction was not disclosed.

The sale is expected to close during the fourth quarter and is subject to the completion of due diligence by Frontier, negotiation of a definitive agreement, the approval of the stockholders of ACCEL, regulatory approvals and customary conditions.

ACCEL said it expects the sale will enable the company to retire all of its debt and increase the capital surplus of its property and casualty insurance subsidiary, Acceleration National Insurance Co.

Thomas H. Friedberg, chairman, president and chief executive officer, said that while the decision to sell the auto after-market product group was "a particularly difficult one," the board concluded that the sale is in the best interests of ACCEL and its stockholders.

While the credit life and health insurance business being sold has performed "consistently well," the capital resources necessary to achieve continued growth and preserve stockholder value in the present competitive environment are not readily available, he said.
